fields.note: The Arabic season infobox gives the finish as the month 'مايو 2027' only, and the English article says the same ('scheduled to conclude in May 2027'). The QSL site publishes the second-leg calendar (bulletin of 14 November 2026) but only as a PDF fixture list, so no textual final-round day was found. Nothing to replace the 05-23 default with.

fields.quote: أعلنت مؤسسة دوري نجوم قطر جدول مباريات دوري QSL2 للموسم الرياضي 2026-2027، والذي تنطلق منافساته يوم 23 أغسطس 2026 بمشاركة 12 فريقاً ... على أن يتم الإعلان لاحقاً عن ملاعب ومواعيد مباريات الجولة الرابعة وما بعدها
fields.note: QU2L is the second tier, run as QSL2 (12 teams, including B sides and the Qatar U23 team). Neither English nor Arabic Wikipedia has a 2026-27 season article for the Qatar Second Division League, and the QSL release that announced the QSL2 calendar covers only rounds 1-3 (venue and dates for round 4 onward still to be announced), so there is no end date at all - nothing to replace the 05-23 default with. Side finding, not written to the asset: that same release dates the QSL2 opener 23 August 2026, three days later than the 08-20 start the record inherited from QSL; it is not clear enough whether QSL2 is officially the same competition as the Second Division League to change the start.
